# Native core app kit 1.1.0

Major 1 now defaults to 1.1.0 on the next launch; 1.0.0 is retained for host
rollback. The host installs frozen `window.native.kit` synchronously before the
first author script. No imports, npm, JSX compiler or build are required.
An unavailable requested major refuses `kit_major_unavailable`.

## Prepare an install from Native MCP alone

Create the complete HTML as a `Document/artifact` with runtime `native.html.v1`.
Use its write receipt's `body_digest` (or body-carrying `source_event_id`) to call
`artifacts_read.manage_alpha_tabs.prepare_install` through `call_executor`:

```json
{"executor":"artifacts_read","operation":"manage_alpha_tabs.prepare_install","arguments":{"artifact_id":"<source id>","expected_body_digest":"<body_digest>","package":"agent.my-app","version":"1.0.0","declaration":{"needs":[],"effects":[]},"reason":"Install my authored app"}}
```

Include your actual consent declaration, including each SQL snapshot need.
When `ready` is true, pass the returned `next_call` to `call_executor`, adding
your `run_key`. It contains the server-computed digests, source revision and
install/update event precondition; no shell, hash computation or build is needed.
When false, read the bounded findings, fix the source/declaration and prepare again.
Malformed package/version/reason/request/guard arguments and authority failures
are normal API errors, rather than `ready:false` findings. Preparation caps the
echoed declaration at 65,536 serialized JSON bytes; `require_declaration` has
entry limits but no total byte cap. An optional `request` is validated and passed
through, including a reinstall over a removed tab; updates must preserve it.
Kit availability is advisory against the packaged default; delivery checks its
own selection. Preparation grants nothing, installs nothing and locks nothing.
The returned revision pins historical bytes; later source edits do not silently
replace them. Re-prepare after edits. Current update CAS and consent rules still
apply. `ready:true` means prepared, not usable. Read `adoption`: when it is
`requires_person_preview_adopt`, tell the signed-in person to Preview/Adopt after
install/update; MCP cannot mint that authority. `carried` means the update can
carry proven adoption for an unchanged canonical declaration. An unadopted
predecessor still requires Preview/Adopt even when the declaration is unchanged.

Alpha tabs pin a package/version/digest, a viewable live `Document/artifact`, its
source revision and consented needs/effects. Updates check exact bytes/digest and
event CAS, preserving status/request. Keyed retries return the original receipt
and current install without reapplying. Disable/restore/remove use event CAS;
disabled or removed tabs stop reads/actions. Target resolution fails closed;
inspect `target_resolves`. List before reorder: reorder replaces the strip order,
appends omitted installs, and refuses unknown/removed/duplicate entries. Without
a saved order, the strip uses agents/folders/tasks/graph/installs.

Preview checks exact source/digest and returns sample HTML with an expiring
account/pin/session receipt; it writes nothing. Preview/adopt/adopt_authored
require a hosted cookie and trusted Origin, never Bearer credentials. Adopt
checks the receipt, pin, event and attestation. Launch checks adoption, event,
View and source; its one-use URL delivers sample input only, without live rows.
`live_read` returns only the caller's authorized consented inputs:
`attention.query.v1` at `input.records`, up to eight `sql.snapshot.v1` SELECT/WITH
needs with 200 rows each at `input.sql[key]`. `params[0]` binds `?1`; omitted
optional parameters bind NULL. Use `live_read.need` to request a consented `records.search.v1` with
`params:{query,limit}` (`limit` at most 30), `records.resolve_reference.v1` with
`params:{reference}`, or a SQL need by key with its declared parameter schema.
Omit `need` for the snapshot. Subscriptions are connection-bound; use the stream-frame token;
subscriptions and `if_revision` apply only to snapshot reads. An `if_revision`
equal to `revision_digest` returns `unchanged:true` with pins/revision and no rows.
Use `if_revision` to resynchronize. Revision information includes `id` and
`time_dependent`; `now_ms()` uses `as_of_ms`. `subscribe_refused` includes the
read. `live_unsubscribe` is idempotent and connection-scoped.
`admit_reveal_target` checks consented `surface.reveal.v1` and one visible
canonical target/pin; delivery is push-only, never via `live_read`.
Supply the full record id or a reserved id such as `native:root`; prefixes refuse.

## A source-only feed app

This complete source-only app displays a declared `records.recent` param-less
`sql.snapshot.v1` feed. Declare that need in the install declaration; the kit
policy below adds no data permission. Use this exact declaration:

```json
{
  "needs": [
    {
      "need": "sql.snapshot.v1",
      "key": "records.recent",
      "label": "Up to 200 visible records, newest first",
      "sql": "SELECT id, substr(name, 1, 160) AS name, type, kind, updated_at FROM records WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facet_values fv WHERE fv.record_id = records.id AND fv.key = 'archived') ORDER BY updated_at_ms DESC, id ASC LIMIT 200"
    }
  ],
  "effects": []
}
```

The SQL selects `id` and `name`, the columns the example renders. Apps own
CSS; the components use simple `kit-*` classes and add no reset.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Recent notes</title>
<script type="application/json" id="native-app-kit">{"schema":"native.app-kit.v1","major":1}</script>
<style>body{font:16px system-ui;margin:2rem}.kit-record-link{cursor:pointer}</style>
</head><body><main id="app">Opening Native…</main>
<script type="module">
const kit = window.native?.kit;
const root = document.getElementById('app');
if (!kit?.preact) root.textContent = 'Open in a Native host with core kit 1.1.0.';
else {
  const { html, render, useFeed, Loading, Empty, ErrorState, RecordLink } = kit.preact;
  function App() {
    const feed = useFeed('records.recent');
    if (feed.status === 'loading') return html`<${Loading} what="notes" />`;
    const result = feed.status === 'ready' ? feed.result : feed.last;
    return html`<section><h1>Recent notes</h1>
      ${feed.status === 'error' && html`<${ErrorState} error=${feed.error} />`}
      ${feed.status === 'error' && result && html`<p>Last good rows; may be out of date.</p>`}
      ${result && html`<p>${kit.countLabel(result)} notes</p>`}
      ${result?.rows.length ? html`<ul>${result.rows.map(row => html`<li key=${row.id}>
        <${RecordLink} id=${row.id}>${row.name || row.id}<//></li>`)}</ul>`
        : html`<${Empty}>No notes delivered.<//>`}
    </section>`;
  }
  try { await kit.ready; render(html`<${App} />`, root); }
  catch (error) { root.textContent = 'Native could not initialize this app.'; }
  addEventListener('pagehide', () => render(null, root), { once: true });
}
</script></body></html>
```

`kit.preact` supplies one Preact instance: `h`, `render`, `Fragment`,
`createContext`, standard hooks, and `html = htm.bind(h)`. Use its hooks for its
components. `useFeed(key)` uses core snapshots; `useQueryFeed(query)` waits for
ready and uses the optional negotiated app-v2 `window.native.subscribe`.
Equivalent JSON query values keep the subscription; changed queries and
unmounts unsubscribe and suppress late deliveries. Errors retain last-good
rows and delivery time. Inside a v2 component, pass `feed.retry`
to the retry button:

```js
const feed = kit.preact.useQueryFeed({ sql: 'SELECT id, name FROM records LIMIT 20' });
if (feed.status === 'error')
  return html`<${ErrorState} error=${feed.error} onRetry=${feed.retry} />`;
```

`retry()` resubscribes to the same query; a terminal error closes the old
subscription. Hooks mounted after kit disposal return a `closed` error.
Query answers have `truncated`, not a total count.

A ready result is `{ rows, columns, truncated, cached? }`. Rows of a `{ sql }`
query, like snapshot rows, are objects keyed by column name: read `row.id`, not
`row[0]`. `columns` names them in select order. Rows of a structured `{ steps }`
query are arrays aligned with `columns` (`id`, `type`, `kind`, `name`,
`summary`, `home_id`, `lifecycle`, `maturity`, `updated_at`,
`last_activity_at`). To accept either shape, use
`Array.isArray(row) ? Object.fromEntries(columns.map((c, i) => [c, row[i]])) : row`.
A host without subscriptions returns `status: 'unsupported'` with an explicit
message. Core major 1 never grants app-v2 authority to an app-v1 install.

For an app-v2 install, negotiated `query`, `subscribe` and `call` may also be
used directly after `kit.ready`. Check each optional method. A write is saved
only when `call(operation, args).confirmed` resolves; dispatch is not a receipt.
Initial Preview/Adopt still requires the person's browser gesture.

`Loading`, `Empty`, `ErrorState` (optional retry), `PreviewBanner`, `Markdown`
(`source`), `Avatar` (initials), `IconSvg` (app-owned children), and `RecordLink`
(`id`) are supplied. Mount `PreviewBanner` only for known sample/preview mode.
Markdown reuses the kit parser: raw HTML stays text, images show alt text,
entities decode through an inert browser resolver, and navigation uses core
attributes and trusted user activation. No editor, comments or CSS are supplied.
Prepared documents retain their selected release. Kit bytes are exempt from
author size/digest accounting; source and declaration still define the app pin.

Release `1.1.0`, major `1`, layer `core`. Factory `native.app-kit.core.factory.v1`; bridge `native.html.bridge.v1`.

JS SHA-256: `060abc96efa6d41cce9889904a23c4861f9f2c1af6619f34a052f8659d35d8db`

Types SHA-256: `64935eb9aa0ef6b1b09b597892240f007cdfc6d3fef36a2c5b9cde73e86161fd`

```typescript
// Native core app kit — AGPL-3.0-only; Copyright Native contributors.
// Release 1.1.0; major 1; native.app-kit.core.factory.v1; native.html.bridge.v1
declare namespace NativeAppKit {
  interface KitRelease {
      readonly version: string;
      readonly major: number;
      readonly layer: "core";
      readonly factory: "native.app-kit.core.factory.v1";
      readonly bridge: "native.html.bridge.v1";
      readonly js_sha256: string;
      readonly types_sha256: string;
  }

  /** One result row, keyed by output column name. */
  type Row = Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;

  /**
   * One capped answer. `rows` is what was delivered; `truncated` says the
   * answer is a prefix. `rowCount` is a total only while `rowCountComplete` is
   * true, otherwise it is a floor ("more than N"). An app must show both.
   */
  interface QueryResult {
      readonly label: string;
      readonly columns: readonly string[];
      readonly rows: readonly Row[];
      readonly rowCount: number;
      readonly rowCountComplete: boolean;
      readonly truncated: boolean;
      /**
       * Set only on a result the host served from its cache, ahead of the
       * revalidation that follows it (a remount). It clears on the next uncached
       * delivery, even if the rows are equal. The host sends nothing for a
       * revalidation that finds equal rows, so then the flag stays set: do not
       * treat it as proof the rows are stale, only as "served from cache".
       */
      readonly cached?: boolean;
      /**
       * Set only on the `last` rows of an error feed whose subscription has ended
       * for good (a terminal error): nothing will refresh them, so they may be out
       * of date. They are kept for display; do not present them as current.
       */
      readonly stale?: boolean;
      /**
       * Only for the host-pushed keyed needs (`HOST_PUSHED_KEYED_NEEDS`): the
       * opaque handle the host minted for this parameter variant. The host names
       * it in `keyed_freshness.changed` when the variant's rows move.
       */
      readonly variant?: string;
  }

  /** Why a port call failed. Stable, app-facing; adapters map their transport onto it. */
  type PortErrorCode = "busy" | "timeout" | "undeclared" | "refused" | "unavailable" | "malformed" | "closed";

  /** Stable diagnostic shape; no transport or write capability. */
  interface KitError extends Error {
      readonly code: PortErrorCode;
      readonly detail?: string;
  }

  /** What a live subscription is showing right now. Errors keep the last good result. */
  type Feed<T> = {
      readonly status: "loading";
  } | {
      readonly status: "ready";
      readonly result: T;
  } | {
      readonly status: "error";
      readonly error: KitError;
      readonly last?: T;
  };

  /** Apps own DOM and CSS; all data comes from their declared snapshots. */
  interface CoreKitBase {
      readonly release: KitRelease;
      readonly ready: Promise<void>;
      read(key: string): Promise<QueryResult>;
      subscribe(key: string, listener: (feed: Feed<QueryResult>) => void): () => void;
      countLabel(result: QueryResult): string;
      errorText(error: Pick<KitError, "code">): string;
      recordLink(id: string): {
          readonly "data-native-record-id": string;
      };
      externalLink(url: string): {
          readonly "data-native-external-url": string;
      };
  }

  /** Structural UI types: source apps need no npm declarations. */
  type UiChild = object | string | number | bigint | boolean | null | undefined | readonly UiChild[];

  type UiComponent<P = {}> = (props: P & {
      children?: UiChild;
  }) => UiChild;

  interface UiElement {
      readonly type: string | Function;
      readonly props: object;
      readonly key: string | number | null;
  }

  interface UiContext<T> {
      Provider: UiComponent<{
          value: T;
      }>;
      Consumer: UiComponent<{
          children: (value: T) => UiChild;
      }>;
  }

  type StateUpdate<T> = T | ((previous: T) => T);

  interface UiRef<T> {
      current: T;
  }

  type Effect = () => void | (() => void);

  interface AppQuery {
      readonly sql: string;
      readonly params?: readonly unknown[];
  }

  interface StepsQuery {
      readonly steps: readonly unknown[];
      readonly order?: string;
      readonly limit?: number;
      readonly offset?: number;
  }

  interface AppQueryResult {
      readonly rows: readonly unknown[];
      readonly columns: readonly unknown[];
      readonly truncated: boolean;
      readonly cached?: boolean;
  }

  type QueryFeedState = {
      readonly status: 'loading';
  } | {
      readonly status: 'unsupported';
      readonly message: string;
  } | {
      readonly status: 'ready';
      readonly result: AppQueryResult;
      readonly deliveredAt: number;
  } | {
      readonly status: 'error';
      readonly error: {
          readonly code: string;
          readonly message: string;
          readonly terminal: boolean;
      };
      readonly last?: AppQueryResult;
      readonly deliveredAt?: number;
  };

  type QueryFeed = QueryFeedState & {
      readonly retry: () => void;
  };

  interface PreactKit {
      h<P>(type: string | UiComponent<P>, props: P | null, ...children: UiChild[]): UiElement;
      render(child: UiChild, parent: Element | Document | ShadowRoot): void;
      readonly Fragment: UiComponent;
      createContext<T>(value: T): UiContext<T>;
      html(strings: TemplateStringsArray, ...values: unknown[]): UiChild;
      useState<T>(initial: T | (() => T)): [
          T,
          (value: StateUpdate<T>) => void
      ];
      useState<T = undefined>(): [
          T | undefined,
          (value: StateUpdate<T | undefined>) => void
      ];
      useReducer<S, A>(reducer: (state: S, action: A) => S, initial: S): [
          S,
          (action: A) => void
      ];
      useReducer<S, A, I>(reducer: (state: S, action: A) => S, initial: I, init: (initial: I) => S): [
          S,
          (action: A) => void
      ];
      useRef<T>(initial: T): UiRef<T>;
      useRef<T>(initial: T | null): UiRef<T | null>;
      useRef<T = undefined>(): UiRef<T | undefined>;
      useEffect(effect: Effect, dependencies?: readonly unknown[]): void;
      useLayoutEffect(effect: Effect, dependencies?: readonly unknown[]): void;
      useMemo<T>(factory: () => T, dependencies: readonly unknown[]): T;
      useCallback<T extends Function>(callback: T, dependencies: readonly unknown[]): T;
      useContext<T>(context: UiContext<T>): T;
      useImperativeHandle<T>(ref: UiRef<T> | ((value: T | null) => void) | null, create: () => T, dependencies?: readonly unknown[]): void;
      useDebugValue<T>(value: T, format?: (value: T) => unknown): void;
      useErrorBoundary(callback?: (error: unknown, info: unknown) => void): [
          unknown,
          () => void
      ];
      useId(): string;
      useFeed(key: string): Feed<QueryResult>;
      /** Query must be JSON serializable; equivalent values share a subscription. */
      useQueryFeed(query: AppQuery | StepsQuery): QueryFeed;
      readonly Loading: UiComponent<{
          what?: string;
      }>;
      readonly Empty: UiComponent;
      readonly ErrorState: UiComponent<{
          error: Pick<KitError, 'code'> & {
              message?: string;
          };
          onRetry?: () => void;
      }>;
      /** Mount only when the host explicitly identifies sample/preview mode. */
      readonly PreviewBanner: UiComponent;
      readonly Markdown: UiComponent<{
          source: string;
          className?: string;
      }>;
      readonly Avatar: UiComponent<{
          name?: string;
          initials?: string;
          title?: string;
          className?: string;
      }>;
      readonly IconSvg: UiComponent<{
          children?: UiChild;
          title?: string;
          viewBox?: string;
          className?: string;
      }>;
      readonly RecordLink: UiComponent<{
          id: string;
          children?: UiChild;
          className?: string;
      }>;
  }

  interface CoreKit extends CoreKitBase {
      readonly preact: PreactKit;
  }

  type QueryDelivery = (AppQueryResult & {
      readonly status: 'ready';
  }) | {
      readonly status: 'error';
      readonly code: string;
      readonly message: string;
      readonly terminal: boolean;
  };

  interface AppCall {
      readonly request_id: string;
      readonly confirmed: Promise<unknown>;
  }

  /** Data methods exist only after app-v2 negotiation; kit policy grants no data authority. */
  interface Host {
      readonly kit?: CoreKit;
      query?(query: AppQuery | StepsQuery): Promise<AppQueryResult>;
      subscribe?(query: AppQuery | StepsQuery, listener: (delivery: QueryDelivery) => void): () => void;
      call?(operation: string, args?: Record<string, unknown>): AppCall;
  }
}
interface Window { readonly native?: NativeAppKit.Host }
```
